description:
Fire Marshal Mac teaches kids simple, memorable fire safety lessons through read-along stories. Follow along with Mac, the kids, and their dog as they learn how to stay safe at home and in the community.

Written by Jay C. McGraw, CFO, FM, a fire marshal and fire-and-life-safety educator.
